comments.comment: 1:23 "its still burning the fuel as embers" incorrect gav' a backdraft occurs when all the oxygen is consumed by a fire and then more oxygen is reintroduced, as the fuel is burned it produces super heated gas which then ignites and burns, the fuel is not still burning when the oxygen is used up, as the fire chokes out, the fuel continues to produce flammable superheated gas which rapidly accumulates in the confined space of the building, but because there is no oxygen for the superheated gas to mix with and combust, the fuel simply continues to accumulate gas, while still retaining its superheated temperature thanks to the confined nature of the space, and the moment oxygen is reintroduced into the space, the superheated gas then self ignites, all at once, producing an explosion of flame and burning gas.
